card.name: Second number in hour ranges
card.fires_on: The last digit of the upper number in a time range like 24 to 72 or 8-12 hours, just before the word hours. Also fires on a few other range-ending spots, such as 'to the end of the infusion'.

modes.label: Hour range endpoint
modes.description: The final digit of the upper bound in a range of hours, right before 'hours'.
modes.example: especially within the first 24-7<<2>> hours of initiating therapy

modes.label: Other range or ratio ends
modes.description: The closing item of a span or ratio, such as a letter in d- to l- or the word end of a time span.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that complete a span or measure, with little clear link to the suppressed tokens.
card.plain: It marks the end of a time range, like the 72 in 24 to 72 hours.
